prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your goals. I can either shortlist top agents for you now, or help you choose one by criteria. Quick guidance plus a plan:

Questions so I can help you best
- What’s the address or neighborhood (Pleasanton has distinct submarkets)?
- Home type and estimated list price (single-family, condo, 3-bed, luxury, etc.)?
- Timeline (sell quickly vs. wait for top price)?
- Priorities: highest net proceeds, lowest commission, full-service marketing, help with staging/repairs, or dual buy-and-sell help?

How I can help
- If you give the address or ZIP I will produce a 3–5 person shortlist of top local agents based on recent closed sales, list-to-sale ratios, client reviews and marketing examples.
- Or I can give a comparison checklist and scripts so you can interview agents yourself.

What “best” agents usually deliver — things to look for
- Strong local track record: multiple recent closed sales in your Pleasanton neighborhood
- High sale-to-list price ratio and low average days on market (DOM)
- Clear, written marketing plan: professional photos, floor plans, targeted online ads, broker outreach, and open house strategy
- Good reviews and references from recent sellers (ask for 2–3)
- Transparent pricing and net-proceeds estimates (running a CMA)
- Experience with your price tier (luxury vs starter) and property type
- Availability and communication style you prefer

Interview questions to ask every agent
- How many homes like mine have you sold in the last 12 months in Pleasanton? Can you show comps?
- What’s your recommended list price and expected net proceeds? (Ask for a written CMA.)
- What is your marketing plan and timeline? (Photos, staging, online ads, target buyers)
- How do you handle showings and open houses?
- What is your commission and any additional fees?
- Can you provide 2–3 recent seller references?
- What separates you from other Pleasanton agents?

How to verify claims
- Check county records or MLS for closed sales
- Look at multiple review sites (Google/Yelp/Redfin/Zillow) and recent client references
- Ask to see samples of their marketing materials and recent listing photos

If you want a shortlist
Give me the property address or ZIP and your priorities, and I’ll pull a short ranked list of top Pleasanton agents with reasons to contact each and suggested questions customized to your home.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
